preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: Input string must contain only alphabetic characters and digits.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() and int(c) <= 26 for c in input_string.split('a'))
preconditions.description: Numbers representing letters (n <= 26) must be separated by letters.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Output string must contain only alphabetic characters and digits.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() and int(c) <= 26 for c in return_value.split('a'))
postconditions.description: Numbers representing letters (n <= 26) must be separated by letters in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(alphabetnums[c] == d for c, d in zip(input_string, return_value) if c.isalpha())
postconditions.description: Each alphabetic character in the input string is converted to its corresponding numeric representation in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(alphabet[int(c)-1] == d for c, d in zip(input_string, return_value) if c.isdigit())
postconditions.description: Each numeric character in the input string is converted to its corresponding alphabetic representation in the output string.
